static_review.identity_binding: fluid::plan fixes root ordinal 0 and each child ordinal; the nonempty plan enters the intent binding, reservation and receipt. contents::reservation_matches compares the full fluid plan. apply uses the reserved world and deterministic child identities/transactions.
static_review.current_authority: apply is internal and runs within the existing claim commit transaction after recovery/current character admission checks; no new authority-bearing entry point is exposed.
static_review.temporal_replay: The receipt replay branch precedes apply. A committed claim therefore cannot refill a subsequently emptied item. Initialization SQL requires the matching reservation and receipt from the current transaction and the exact fresh minted item.
static_review.atomicity: Root and all child rows are inserted in the same claim transaction. Migration0969 installs the fresh-state proof and deferred complete-plan receipt check; dropped writes or mismatched subtypes fail the entire claim.
static_review.bounds: Request contents and SQL plan limits bound iteration; the existing 0762 partial GIN contents-plan index covers child receipt lookups.
static_review.reference_scope: No production recipe or subtype was inferred; unresolved source choices remain coordinator work.

runtime_limitations: Focused PostgreSQL case selected but failed on connection setup before database work; no POSTGRES_CASE_COMPLETED marker.
Unit results are separate and cannot qualify SQL atomicity, persistence/restart, current-authority negative cases, or real dispatch.
